title: Bulgur and feta patties with radish salad

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or plain staple: bulgur, tinned chickpeas, feta, eggs, flour, Greek yoghurt and fresh vegetables.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at Tesco or any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a bowl, a masher and a frying pan, and shaping and frying patties is within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: A 2:1 water-to-bulgur soak, a full tin of chickpeas, egg and flour to bind, and 8 patties with a 300g radish salad and yoghurt make a sound dinner for four.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes is enough to slice the vegetables, mash, mix and shape while the bulgur soaks, and the 15-minute soak plus about 8 minutes of frying roughly matches the 20 printed.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the mint and lemon, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: A crunchy 300g radish and cucumber salad with mint is a substantial named half of the plate and suits a late-May evening.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a neighbour could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Pulses, wholegrain, cheese, egg and a fresh salad make a filling, balanced family dinner.
